The survey behind the study

The findings come from the sixth round of a large European survey, carried out in 2012 and 2013 across 29 countries. Once people who had not stated their earnings in full had been set aside, (37) ........ respondents were left in the analysis. How common regular volunteering was differed sharply from one country to another: in Germany, the Netherlands and Norway more than (38) ........ of those questioned said they took part, against fewer than one in ten in Bulgaria, Hungary and Lithuania. Turning to the money side of the story, the share of the link between volunteering and health that the income figures could not reach came to (39) ........ . As a further check, the team looked separately at the (40) ........ or so of the original sample who would not say what they earned, in case those people were unlike the rest.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Once the strength of the earnings route was measured, though, it emerged that income carried (37) ........ of the overall link, with the remainder running through something the income figures could not reach.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Income differences accounted for well under a fifth of the total association between volunteering and self-rated health.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Paketin dordu birden E7 2/2 parcasiz olcumunde dogru bilindi (dayanak: logic). Kok sebep tek tek kalemlerde degil paketin kurulusundaydi: kelime bankasi soyut nitelemelerden olusuyordu ('a small part', 'stable', 'unproven suggestions', 'a link rather than a cause') ve ozet metni yazinin muhakemesini bastan sona anlatiyordu; parcasiz bir aday yalnizca soylem mantigini izleyerek dordunu de yerlestirebiliyordu. Ayrica bu kalemin kaniti (F/2) baslik eslestirmesinin 31. kalemiyle ORTAKTI, yani tek cumlede iki soru vardi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Paket bastan kuruldu. Bosluklar artik nitelemelere degil metnin kendi sectigi DEGERLERE aciliyor (sayi, oran, yuzde), boylece muhakemeyle doldurulamiyor; bunu mumkun kilmak icin kelime bankasi kaldirildi ve gorev 'pasajdan en cok uc kelime ve/veya bir sayi' bicimine gecirildi (soru tipi degismedi). Ozetin konusu da yazinin muhakemesinden (E-I) arastirmanin verisine kaydirildi. Bu kalem F/2'den B/2'ye tasindi; F/2'deki cumle cakismasi kalkti.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The team then repeated the analysis with narrower samples, with different thresholds for how often someone had to help out before they were classed as a volunteer, and with extra background variables added; across those versions the picture was (38) ........ .
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: In every version of the analysis the same basic pattern held: a small, statistically reliable health advantage for volunteers, only a modest share of which ran through income.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi ve soylem mantigi bir arada: 'dayaniklilik sinamalari yapildi' diye baslayan bir cumlenin sonundaki bosluk, bankadaki tek 'degismedi' anlamli secenegi ('stable') zorunlu kiliyordu; parcaya bakmaya gerek kalmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk bir nitelemeden bir ORANA cevrildi ve kanit G/3'ten D/2'ye, ulkeler arasi gonulluluk oranlarina tasindi. Cevap ('four in ten') metnin verdigi bir sayi; ozetin kalan kismi karsi ucu ('fewer than one in ten') verili olarak tasidigi icin bosluga muhakemeyle ulasmak mumkun degil, sayiyi bulmak gerekiyor.

yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The authors suggest several candidate explanations for this unexplained majority of the effect, while stressing that their data cannot confirm any of them directly.
